name: descript
description: Import media, edit with Underlord, publish share links, and export transcripts or Premiere/Resolve timelines — from your agent.

interface.longDescription: Descript lets you edit video and audio by editing text. Import media from URLs or file uploads, create projects, and use Underlord — Descript's AI co-editor — to trim, rearrange, remove filler words, add captions, and more. Publish a shareable link, or export a transcript or a Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve timeline, all from your assistant. In ChatGPT, open the Descript sidebar to browse your projects, pick a project and composition for your next request, and upload files into a new project while you watch the progress.
defaultPrompt: Create a video project from these clips and remove the filler words
Publish my project as a shareable video link
Export my project's transcript as an SRT file

positive.prompt: Open Descript and show me my projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Descript sidebar with a read-only list of the signed-in account's projects and their compositions. Nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: Edit the project and composition selected in the sidebar
positive.prompt: Remove the filler words from the composition I selected in Descript.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the project and composition selected in the sidebar without asking for them again, starts an Underlord edit, reports its progress, and confirms when the edit is done.

positive.description: Upload files into a new project
positive.prompt: Upload a video file into a new Descript project.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Descript upload panel. After the user adds a file, it creates a new project, shows upload and import progress, and returns the project link when the import finishes.

positive.prompt: Publish the Descript project I selected as a shareable video link.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to confirm before publishing, publishes the selected composition, and returns the share link and download link exactly as Descript returns them.

positive.prompt: Export the transcript of my most recent Descript project as an SRT file.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent project, exports its transcript in SRT format, and shows the transcript text. Nothing in the project is changed.

negative.description: Deleting a project, which Descript does not support from the chat
negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete or change anything. Says projects cannot be deleted from the chat and suggests deleting it in the Descript app.

negative.description: Opening a project that belongs to another user
negative.prompt: Open the Descript project my coworker is working on and show me their edits.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not guess project IDs or show anything outside the signed-in account's Drive. Says it can only reach projects the signed-in account can access.

negative.prompt: What is a good recipe for banana bread?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any Descript tool.

publication.release_notes: Adds a Descript sidebar in ChatGPT. Browse your projects and compositions, select one to use as context for Underlord edits, publishing, and transcript exports, and upload files into a new project with live upload and import progress.
